statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116317 (PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd() heap buffer overflow may execute arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116317/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116317, lists 16 as affected before 16.16. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/2d7573b0098d035db01a742bb1475d4a7f45ff57, which changes src/backend/utils/adt/tsrank.c and src/include/tsearch/ts_type.h, carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116317" and is contained in the REL_16_16 tag. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116317 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change those files. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 package for Alpine 3.23 is built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball, and its postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64. Every earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) is an upstream release before 16.16, and its postgres server binary reports that older 16.x release on both architectures, so it is affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116317 (PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd() heap buffer overflow may execute arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for major version 17. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116317/, lists 17.12 as the fixed release for 17, the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116317, lists 17 as affected before 17.12. The fix on the REL_17_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/7f8424ece5d078becf0c018ef33e3866218de023, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116317", is contained in the REL_17_12 tag and not in REL_17_11, and changes get_docrep() in src/backend/utils/adt/tsrank.c, so that ts_rank_cd() drops query items beyond the space it allocated instead of writing past it, and updates a comment in src/include/tsearch/ts_type.h. Alpine's postgresql17 17.12-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 17.12 release and lists CVE-2026-116317 under 17.12-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql17 17.12-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 17.12 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (main and security, x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql17 at 17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0. The vulnerable code is in the postgres server binary, usr/libexec/postgresql17/postgres, in the postgresql17 package. In the 17.12-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0 and 17.11-r0) it reports that older 17.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 17.12, so they are affected; 17.12-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116317 (PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd() heap buffer overflow may execute arbitrary code) in 18.7: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116317/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for major version 18, and the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/3e97c9a1fa19fb995e57a1a093cb7cee3f6da605 on the REL_18_STABLE branch, which changes src/backend/utils/adt/tsrank.c and src/include/tsearch/ts_type.h so that get_docrep(), which ts_rank_cd() uses, drops items beyond the space it allocated instead of overrunning it; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-116317 and Backpatch-through: 14; it is in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres, in every published postgresql18 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 18.7-r0 reports PostgreSQL 18.7 and carries the fix, while the earlier builds 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0 report 18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4 and 18.6 and are affected. 18.7-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix. Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-116317 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116317, a heap buffer overflow in ts_rank_cd() on an invalid tsvector with duplicate positions, in 17.12; earlier 17 releases are affected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116317/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116317). The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
